title: Parker House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Bask in the serenity of coastal living at this sunlit, breezy retreat, ideally within a short stroll from direct beach access. Set behind the secure gates of an exclusive community, this home offers many amenities, including two sparkling pools, a miniature golf course, a playground, several parks, and charming tree-lined paths perfect for biking or walking. The interior radiates warmth with its coastal decor and natural light, while multiple porches, swings, benches, and plush furnishings provide ample space for relaxation and connection with your loved ones. The guest house, complete with a kitchenette, serves as a perfect sanctuary for those seeking additional privacy. As the sun sets, gather in one of the inviting dining areas to share a meal and enjoy games, creating cherished memories. For those eager to explore, the community offers a variety of dining, shopping, and entertainment options just steps away from your door. Whether savoring a morning coffee on the porch or unwinding in the luxurious guest house, this coastal haven promises an unparalleled experience of comfort and tranquility. Here, every detail is thoughtfully designed to ensure a stay that is as rejuvenating as it is unforgettable.
